translations.web: Now he who betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”
translations.bsb: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The One I kiss is the man; arrest Him.”
translations.kjv: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
translations.asv: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that is he: take him.
